# Code39 standard symbol table reference

`frontend/src/features/labels/barcode.ts` uses the standard Code39 symbol mapping also published by ZXing, Copyright 2008 ZXing authors, Apache License 2.0. Reference: https://github.com/zxing/zxing/blob/zxing-3.5.3/core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/Code39Reader.java

The restricted validation/encoding and UI are written for this project; no ZXing runtime package is bundled. The Apache 2.0 license text is retained here for the referenced mapping. No endorsement or physical printing/scanner certification is implied.
